verdict.rationale: Programmatic control is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is that packages, tools and runtimes are available with a single command, plus command-line container tooling. Nothing shows a general API covering the GUI features (performance mode, Do Not Disturb, dark mode, online accounts, app installs via the button). Missing for 10: any documented API or CLI equivalent for the desktop UI settings and apps, evidence of UI-to-API parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted control.
